description: Pinned third-party sources vendored under third_party/. Checked by cmake/ValidateVendor.cmake; no network access during configure or build.

dependencies.name: Dear ImGui
dependencies.purpose: Editor UI (docking branch); renderer backends only, the platform/input adapter is in-house

dependencies.name: Jolt Physics
dependencies.purpose: Physics backend (FR-18, US-052)

dependencies.name: Lua
dependencies.purpose: Lua VM with in-house C API bindings (no sol2); the lua and luac command-line programs, the test hooks, and onelua are not vendored

dependencies.name: GLM
dependencies.purpose: Math primitives; in-house wrappers define engine conventions

dependencies.name: stb
dependencies.purpose: Image decoding, font rasterization, Ogg Vorbis decoding; stb_image_resize2 is only available under deprecated/ at this pin and is vendored from there

dependencies.name: bc7enc_rdo
dependencies.purpose: BC7 encoding; the BC5 encoder and format wrapper live in the converter

dependencies.name: miniaudio
dependencies.purpose: Audio device and mixing adapter

dependencies.name: nlohmann/json
dependencies.purpose: Authoring formats (single-header amalgamation)

dependencies.name: zstd
dependencies.purpose: Pack compression; the whole lib/ tree (Windows DLL projects excluded)

dependencies.name: ImGuizmo
dependencies.purpose: Transform gizmos

dependencies.name: imgui-node-editor
dependencies.purpose: Graph canvas for the material and animation graph editors

dependencies.name: D3D12MemoryAllocator
dependencies.purpose: GPU allocations behind the DX12 RHI; requires the Windows SDK d3d12.h

dependencies.name: VulkanMemoryAllocator
dependencies.purpose: GPU allocations behind the Vulkan RHI

dependencies.name: Vulkan-Headers
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan API headers for the Vulkan RHI and the Vulkan memory allocator; registry/ (vk.xml and generators) is needed by the Vulkan loader and validation layer builds

dependencies.name: Assimp
dependencies.purpose: Model and animation import in the converter; the root CMakeLists.txt and cmake-modules drive the build of code/ and the bundled contrib sources (zlib, unzip, rapidjson, pugixml, and others); draco and gtest excluded

dependencies.name: meshoptimizer
dependencies.purpose: Offline LOD and meshlet generation in the converter; the library sources only (demo, gltf, js, and tools are not vendored)

dependencies.name: SPIRV-Headers
dependencies.purpose: SPIR-V headers for SPIRV-Tools, Vulkan-ValidationLayers, and DirectXShaderCompiler; passed to their builds as SPIRV_HEADER_DIR or DXC_SPIRV_HEADERS_DIR

dependencies.name: SPIRV-Tools
dependencies.purpose: SPIR-V optimizer and validator library. Its top-level CMake adds tools/, test/, and examples/ unconditionally, so those directories are vendored with their CMake files only; test/CMakeLists.txt returns early when SPIRV_SKIP_TESTS is ON (implied by SPIRV_SKIP_EXECUTABLES) and the SPIRV-Tools unit tests are not vendored

dependencies.name: Vulkan-Utility-Libraries
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan helper libraries used by the validation layers; scripts/gn and tests are not vendored

dependencies.name: Vulkan-Loader
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan loader for the Vulkan RHI on Windows and Linux; code generators under scripts/ run with the system Python 3; packaging (gn, qnx) and tests are not vendored

dependencies.name: Vulkan-ValidationLayers
dependencies.purpose: Khronos validation layer for debug and sanitizer-style GPU runs; its own bundled external/ headers are included. mimalloc (optional, USE_MIMALLOC=OFF), glslang and googletest (tests only) are not vendored

dependencies.name: DirectX-Headers
dependencies.purpose: D3D12 headers used by DirectXShaderCompiler on non-Windows hosts; Windows builds use the Windows SDK headers

dependencies.name: DirectXShaderCompiler
dependencies.purpose: HLSL to DXIL and SPIR-V compiler (US-003 builds the host toolchain). The in-tree LLVM/Clang sources it needs are included; test, unittest, example, and docs trees are not. Its DXC_SPIRV_* paths point at the shared SPIRV-Headers/SPIRV-Tools roots

dependencies.name: FidelityFX FSR 2
dependencies.purpose: Temporal upscaling for the full_1080 profile (FSR 2 Quality), with the DX12 and Vulkan backends and their shader sources; sample applications and prebuilt tools/sc binaries are not vendored

dependencies.name: Roboto
dependencies.purpose: Licensed font with Cyrillic coverage for the editor and runtime UI (regular weight only)

systemAbiExceptions.name: Windows SDK
systemAbiExceptions.reason: d3d12.h, dxgi, Win32, Raw Input, XInput; OS headers and import libraries

systemAbiExceptions.name: GPU drivers and Vulkan ICD
systemAbiExceptions.reason: installed on the system; Vulkan headers and loader sources are vendored

systemAbiExceptions.name: X11, XInput2, XIM, evdev, glibc
systemAbiExceptions.reason: Linux system ABI for windowing, input, and the C library

systemAbiExceptions.name: Compilers and standard libraries
systemAbiExceptions.reason: MSVC, Clang, GCC, libc++/libstdc++, and their runtimes

systemAbiExceptions.name: Python 3 interpreter
systemAbiExceptions.reason: build-time code generators for Vulkan-Loader, Vulkan-ValidationLayers, and Vulkan-Utility-Libraries; a system tool, not vendored
